name: GoRetro
description: GoRetro - REST API server for managing retro gaming ROM collections. Generate gamelist XML files, scrape metadata from ScreenScraper, download media, and manage favorites via HTTP API endpoints.

paths.name: ROM Directory
paths.description: Base ROM directory containing system subdirectories (snes/, nes/, etc.). GoRetro reads ROMs from /roms/{system}/ and writes gamelist.xml and media to the same location.

paths.name: Config Directory
paths.description: Configuration directory. Contains config.yaml (edit this!), favorites.yaml, and .cache/ subdirectory. Copy config.yaml.example to config.yaml on first run.

ports.name: API Server Port
ports.description: Port for the GoRetro HTTP API server. Access API at http:// :[PORT]

variables.name: API Key
variables.description: Optional API key for authentication. When set, all API requests must include this key via X-API-Key header or Authorization: Bearer header. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Leave empty to disable authentication.
